cues.en: Instructor: In this video, we are going to use code to explore different distributions, probability distributions that are often used in statistics
cues.zh: 這部影片，要用程式碼探索統計、機率，

cues.en: and probability and other related scientific and mathematical fields.
cues.zh: 以及相關科學、數學領域中，常用的不同機率分布。

cues.en: We will create kind of quote unquote pure distributions.
cues.zh: 會建立所謂「純粹」的分布。

cues.en: Nothing is really pure when it's done on computers because there's always gonna be little precision errors, rounding errors and so on, but sort of theoretical analytic distributions.
cues.zh: 電腦上沒有真正純粹的東西，總有微小精度、四捨五入誤差等，但大致是理論上的解析分布。

cues.en: And we will also be creating random data that follow different shapes of distributions.
cues.zh: 也會建立服從不同分布形狀的隨機資料。

cues.en: All right, so we begin with the most important distribution in possibly all of mathematics and that is the Gaussian distribution or the normal distribution.
cues.zh: 先從可能整個數學最重要的分布開始，也就是高斯、常態分布。

cues.en: I'm going to create this by first creating a variable x.
cues.zh: 先建立變數x。

cues.en: This will be a vector that goes from minus four to plus four in 1001 steps.
cues.zh: 這是從−4到+4，共1001個點的向量。

cues.en: And you might be wondering why I do 1001 and not 1000.
cues.zh: 你可能好奇，為什麼1001，而非1000？

cues.en: Well, that's just the way I wrote the code.
cues.zh: 只是我這樣寫程式。

cues.en: This is also a nicer number. It's symmetric here.
cues.zh: 這個數也比較漂亮，這裡對稱。

cues.en: Anyway, so this vector x is going to be the vector that we evaluate the normal distribution on.
cues.zh: 總之，向量x是用來計算常態分布的取值位置。

cues.en: So you can see I'm using the MATLAB function normpdf.
cues.zh: 可以看到，使用MATLAB的normpdf函式。

cues.en: so that's normal distribution, and pdf stands for probability density function.
cues.zh: norm代表常態分布，pdf代表機率密度函數。

cues.en: In the next section of the course on probability theory, I will describe more about what these probability density functions mean, how to create them, how to interpret them, and so on.
cues.zh: 下一節機率理論，會詳細說明機率密度函數的意思、建立與解讀方式等等。

cues.en: But for now, all you need to know is that this is going to create a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 目前只要知道，它會建立常態分布。

cues.en: This is in the statistics toolbox, by the way.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，它在統計工具箱裡。

cues.en: All right, and then we just make a plot and you will recognize this plot.
cues.zh: 接著畫圖，你應該認得。

cues.en: So this is a Gaussian normal distribution.
cues.zh: 這是高斯、常態分布。

cues.en: I call this an analytic distribution because this is a distribution that is based off of a formula.
cues.zh: 我稱它解析分布，因為以公式為基礎。

cues.en: So this is not a histogram of data that we've measured.
cues.zh: 不是測量資料的直方圖。

cues.en: This is just derived from a formula.
cues.zh: 只是從公式推導。

cues.en: Okay, so here I ask a question in the code, is this a probability distribution?
cues.zh: 這裡在程式碼問一個問題：它是機率分布嗎？

cues.en: And I would like you before, you know, we're going to answer that empirically, but I would like you just to look at this plot and look at the y-axis and determine for yourself
cues.zh: 我們會實際計算答案，但先看看圖與y軸，自己判斷，

cues.en: whether you think this is a probability distribution.
cues.zh: 認不認為它是機率分布。

cues.en: Remember, for this to be a real probability distribution, the values all have to sum up to one.
cues.zh: 記得，要成為真正的機率分布，所有值必須加總為1。

cues.en: So we should see that the sum of all of these numbers here, in this vector here sum up to one.
cues.zh: 所以向量裡，所有這些數的總和，應該是1。

cues.en: Well, that's already pretty obviously the case looking at here because if the top value is 0.4, then the next value is going to be a little bit less than 0.4 and a little bit less than 0.4.
cues.zh: 但看這裡已很明顯，最高值是0.4，下一點略小於0.4，再下一點也略小於0.4。

cues.en: And already, you know, just from these couple of points here, we've already exceeded a value of one.
cues.zh: 光這幾點，就已經超過1。

cues.en: So in fact, let's see what this ends up being.
cues.zh: 實際看看最後是多少。

cues.en: If we sum up all of these numbers, so this is gausdist, that's this vector here, so we can sum up all of these and it turns out to be pretty close to 125.
cues.zh: 把這些數，也就是gausdist向量的所有值相加，結果相當接近125。

cues.en: So this is not a probability distribution, but we can convert this into a probability distribution pretty easily.
cues.zh: 所以不是機率分布，但很容易轉成機率分布。

cues.en: One way is by redefining gausdist to be gausdist divided by the sum of gausdist.
cues.zh: 一種方法，是重新定義gausdist，除以gausdist的總和。

cues.en: So basically we are enforcing that it will have a sum of up to one.
cues.zh: 基本上強制總和為1。

cues.en: So I can show you that here in the code real quick.
cues.zh: 在程式碼快速示範。

cues.en: We can just say divided by the sum of gausdist and then do this plotting again.
cues.zh: 直接除以gausdist總和，再畫一次。

cues.en: Now, you see the values are much, much smaller.
cues.zh: 現在數值小很多。

cues.en: And if you would sum up all of these numbers, you would find that they do indeed sum to one.
cues.zh: 把所有數相加，就會發現確實為1。

cues.en: Okay, but another way to do this is to take a bit of a calculus approach here.
cues.zh: 另一種方式，稍微採用微積分觀點。

cues.en: And the calculus approach is to consider that what we want to equal one is the total area under this curve, so the total area of this function.
cues.zh: 希望等於1的，是曲線下面積，也就是整個函數的面積。

cues.en: And so the way that we compute area in calculus, this is like a Riemann sum kind of approach, is to basically take the heights of all of these individual points.
cues.zh: 微積分計算面積，有點像黎曼和，基本上取每個個別點的高度。

cues.en: You can think of these as individual bars, that would be kind of the Riemann approach.
cues.zh: 可以想成個別長條，這就是黎曼和的做法。

cues.en: So the heights of these bars divided by the width of the bar, that would be the total area.
cues.zh: 長條高度除以寬度，就是總面積。

cues.en: The height times the width gives us the area of each of these bars here, each of these points here.
cues.zh: 高度乘寬度，得到每個長條、每個點的面積。

cues.en: And then we sum all of those up.
cues.zh: 再把它們全部加總。

cues.en: So let's see what happens there.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: So actually, what is dx?
cues.zh: dx到底是什麼？

cues.en: Well, dx is actually the space, the gap between any two points.
cues.zh: 就是任意兩點之間的間隔。

cues.en: And that's basically just the spacing between the successive x points here.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是相鄰x點的間距。

cues.en: So you can see that all of the x points are separated by 0.008.
cues.zh: 可以看到，所有x點相隔0.008。

cues.en: That seems to be what it is here.
cues.zh: 看起來這裡就是如此。

cues.en: So what I'm actually going to do is say diff, which computes the difference, of x, and we only actually need the first two
cues.zh: 所以用diff計算x的差，只需要前兩點，

cues.en: because these are linearly spaced.
cues.zh: 因為這些點線性等距。

cues.en: So the gap between each successive data point in x is exactly the same.
cues.zh: x中相鄰資料點的間隔完全相同。

cues.en: So now let's try sum gausdist times dx,
cues.zh: 現在試sum(gausdist)乘dx，

cues.en: so the spacing between each point, so that's diff of x1:2.
cues.zh: 也就是各點間距，diff(x(1:2))。

cues.en: And lo and behold, we get a number that is, well, it's not exactly one, but it is pretty close.
cues.zh: 結果得到一個，雖然不完全是1，但很接近的數。

cues.en: We can try format long, run this again, you can see that's really, really close to one.
cues.zh: 試format long，再執行，可以看到非常接近1。

cues.en: And in fact, the problem here, this might not be a machine precision error, this might just be that we didn't evaluate this far enough out.
cues.zh: 其實這可能不是機器精度誤差，只是取值範圍不夠遠。

cues.en: So maybe we need to do this to be five to five and then perhaps we will see that it gets even closer.
cues.zh: 也許要從−5到5，可能會更接近。

cues.en: Let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: Yeah, now it's even closer to one.
cues.zh: 對，現在更接近1。

cues.en: So basically, you know, we need to evaluate this further out to get this probability distribution to be exactly one.
cues.zh: 基本上，需要向外計算更遠，讓機率分布總面積恰好是1。

cues.en: But that's okay, you certainly see where this is going.
cues.zh: 不過沒關係，你應該看得出方向。

cues.en: All right, so now that we've created a Gaussian distribution using an analytic formula, we are going to create a normal distribution of random numbers.
cues.zh: 用解析公式建立高斯分布後，接著建立常態分布隨機數。

cues.en: So we are going to generate random numbers that are normally distributed.
cues.zh: 產生服從常態分布的隨機數。

cues.en: And here, I'm just illustrating that you can change the mean, which I call shiftings.
cues.zh: 這裡示範如何改平均值，我稱它shift，平移。

cues.en: That's a shifting parameter.
cues.zh: 這是平移參數。

cues.en: And you can also stretch, which is a variance parameter.
cues.zh: 也能伸縮，是變異數參數。

cues.en: And here's how that gets implemented.
cues.zh: 實作如下。

cues.en: So we take random numbers and the n stands for normal distribution.
cues.zh: 取隨機數，n代表常態分布。

cues.en: So we want an n by one matrix, so a thousand by one matrix, which is just a vector.
cues.zh: 要N×1，也就是1000×1的矩陣，其實是向量。

cues.en: And we multiply by the variance parameter, the stretching parameter, and we add the shifting parameters.
cues.zh: 乘上變異數、伸縮參數，再加平移參數。

cues.en: So you see that we have two parameters that we are using to create this normal distribution, an additive parameter to shift on the y-axis,
cues.zh: 這裡用兩個參數建立常態分布：加法參數用來沿y軸平移，

cues.en: so here that shift value would be zero, and a stretch parameter to change the width of this distribution.
cues.zh: 這裡平移值會是0；伸縮參數則改變分布寬度。

cues.en: Okay, so then we can plot all this.
cues.zh: 接著畫出來。

cues.en: And this is the histogram of those data.
cues.zh: 這是資料直方圖。

cues.en: And you can see that, well, it's not a perfect Gaussian distribution here, but it's certainly very close to a Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 不是完美高斯，但確實非常接近。

cues.en: Also, because these are random numbers, every time I rerun this code, it's gonna look a little bit different.
cues.zh: 因為是隨機數，每次重新執行，都會稍有不同。

cues.en: You can also see that the center here is five.
cues.zh: 也能看到，中心在5。

cues.en: You can quantify this, so mean data equals 5.04.
cues.zh: 可以量化，mean(data)=5.04。

cues.en: Now, you may or may not be surprised that this shift parameter here was set to be exactly five.
cues.zh: shift參數明確設為5，這也許讓你意外，也許不會。

cues.en: And here we got 5.04, so it's not exactly five.
cues.zh: 卻得到5.04，不完全是5。

cues.en: Run this again and now we get a mean that's a little bit smaller.
cues.zh: 再執行，現在平均又稍小一點。

cues.en: This has to do with sampling variability and you'll learn more about sampling variability and how to think about sampling variability in a later video.
cues.zh: 這與抽樣變異有關，之後會學它是什麼，以及如何思考。

cues.en: All right, so this is for a Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 以上是高斯分布。

cues.en: Next, I'm going to show you a uniform distribution.
cues.zh: 接著示範均勻分布。

cues.en: A uniform distribution means that all values within a certain range are equally likely and all values outside that range are not likely,
cues.zh: 均勻分布表示，某範圍內所有值出現機會相同，範圍外則不可能，

cues.en: they basically never occur.
cues.zh: 基本上不會出現。

cues.en: So here's what a plot of uniform data values look like.
cues.zh: 這是均勻分布資料值的圖。

cues.en: You can see I have set this to go from minus 0.5 to plus 1.5.
cues.zh: 可以看到，設成從−0.5到+1.5。

cues.en: And here in the histogram, this does not look like a Gaussian distribution, it doesn't look like a bell curve, it doesn't peak up and down because all of the data values within this range
cues.zh: 直方圖不像高斯、鐘形曲線，不會先升到峰再下降，因為範圍內所有資料值，

cues.en: are equally likely.
cues.zh: 出現機會相同。

cues.en: Given, of course, some, you know, sampling variability, that's gonna make these seem like, you know, some values are more likely in this particular sample, but that's going to change over different samples.
cues.zh: 當然，抽樣變異會讓某個樣本看似有些值更常出現，但換樣本就會改變。

cues.en: Okay, so I will let you spend some time playing around with these parameters and see how that affects the distribution, both the boundaries and the overall shape.
cues.zh: 讓你花點時間調整參數，看看如何影響分布邊界與整體形狀。

cues.en: Next, I'm gonna go to a log normal distribution.
cues.zh: 接著是對數常態分布。

cues.en: And you've already seen log normal distributions before in this course because I've shown you some data simulated using a log normal distribution.
cues.zh: 課程之前已經看過，我展示過用對數常態模擬的資料。

cues.en: Log normal distributions have two key properties that we are often interested in in statistics.
cues.zh: 它有兩個統計中常關注的特性。

cues.en: One is that they're strictly non-negative functions, so they're always above zero.
cues.zh: 第一，是嚴格非負函數，始終高於0。

cues.en: You're never gonna get any values below zero.
cues.zh: 不會有低於0的值。

cues.en: And secondly, log normal distributions always have this really long tail.
cues.zh: 第二，總有這種很長的尾巴。

cues.en: So this actually looks a little bit like the distribution of incomes where you have a lot of people making a reasonable amount of money and a smaller number of people making a lot more money.
cues.zh: 看起來有點像收入分布：很多人收入合理，少數人賺得多很多。

cues.en: All right, and then here I'm going to create an empirical log normal distribution.
cues.zh: 接著建立經驗對數常態分布。

cues.en: And this is what I've illustrated before to you in code.
cues.zh: 之前在程式碼中示範過。

cues.en: So we generate some Gaussian distributed, normally distributed random numbers and then we put those numbers inside the natural exponential and that gives us our log normal distribution.
cues.zh: 產生高斯、常態隨機數，送進自然指數，就得到對數常態分布。

cues.en: So here you see what the data look like and here you see a histogram of those data.
cues.zh: 這是資料樣貌，這是直方圖。

cues.en: Now, I have some questions for you and I would like you to either pause the video now or work through this at the end of the video.
cues.zh: 有幾個問題，請現在暫停，或影片結束後思考。

cues.en: And the issue is about this shift and stretch parameter.
cues.zh: 關於shift與stretch參數。

cues.en: So here, you know, this line of code is actually exactly the same as the line of code from earlier with the Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 這行其實和前面高斯分布的程式碼完全相同。

cues.en: So you might think that this shift parameter, which we set to five, should be the average value.
cues.zh: 你可能以為，設為5的shift參數，應該是平均值。

cues.en: However, when we say mean data, the average value is actually much, much bigger than five.
cues.zh: 但計算mean(data)，平均值其實比5大很多。

cues.en: And same thing with the stretch parameter, we could take the variance or I guess this should correspond to the standard deviation, so the standard deviation of data is 87,
cues.zh: stretch也一樣，取變異數，或者它應該對應標準差，資料的標準差是87，

cues.en: whereas I said here it should be 0.5.
cues.zh: 但這裡設的是0.5。

cues.en: So what is the deal and what can you do?
cues.zh: 怎麼回事，能怎麼做？

cues.en: What transformation can you do to this data, these data here in order to recover the shift and stretch parameter?
cues.zh: 要對資料做什麼轉換，才能找回shift與stretch參數？

cues.en: In other words, the standard deviation and the mean.
cues.zh: 換句話說，標準差與平均值。

cues.en: So that's a little bit of a challenge for you.
cues.zh: 這是個小挑戰。

cues.en: See if you can work that out.
cues.zh: 看看能否想出來。

cues.en: All right, but now I wanna switch to another kind of distribution, which I haven't discussed a lot in the lectures so far, but this is called a binomial distribution.
cues.zh: 現在換另一種，講座中還沒談太多的分布，叫二項分布。

cues.en: So a binomial distribution is the probability of flipping a coin and getting K heads in N coin tosses.
cues.zh: 它表示，擲硬幣N次，得到K次正面的機率。

cues.en: So we take a binary outcome, that's where the binomial comes from.
cues.zh: 取二元結果，二項就是由此而來。

cues.en: So heads versus tails on a coin or, you know, win versus lose in the lottery, or pass versus fail in an exam.
cues.zh: 例如硬幣正反面、彩券中獎或沒中、考試及格或不及格。

cues.en: So we wanna know what is the probability of getting K heads in N coin tosses.
cues.zh: 想知道N次擲硬幣，出現K次正面的機率。

cues.en: And this depends on the probability of getting heads.
cues.zh: 取決於正面的機率。

cues.en: So we can say for a coin, we expect p, the probability, to be 0.5, assuming it's a fair coin.
cues.zh: 公平硬幣，預期p，也就是機率，是0.5。

cues.en: If it was somehow a trick coin, then you know you might get 0.7 if it's more likely to land on heads.
cues.zh: 如果是做手腳的硬幣，可能正面較容易出現，例如0.7。

cues.en: Okay, and so here are the two key parameters of a binomial distribution.
cues.zh: 這是二項分布的兩個關鍵參數。

cues.en: We say that there are N coin tosses and the probability is 0.5.
cues.zh: 擲N次，正面機率0.5。

cues.en: And then what you see here is a histogram of the distribution results.
cues.zh: 這裡是分布結果的直方圖。

cues.en: Now these are all integers, a binomial distribution gives all integers.
cues.zh: 全是整數，二項分布給出整數。

cues.en: And that makes sense when we think about this kind of a problem because, you know, you can't have 3.2 heads out of 10 coin flips.
cues.zh: 這很合理，因為擲十次硬幣，不可能得到3.2次正面。

cues.en: So what you see here are the probability value.
cues.zh: 這裡顯示機率值。

cues.en: So if you flip a coin 10 times, given that it's a fair coin, so it's a probability of 0.5, what is the probability of getting two heads
cues.zh: 公平硬幣、正面機率0.5，擲十次，得到兩次正面的機率，

cues.en: out of 10 flips?
cues.zh: 是多少？

cues.en: Well, it is about 4%.
cues.zh: 大約4%。

cues.en: And not surprising, the peak here is gonna be at five and so on.
cues.zh: 不意外，峰在5，依此類推。

cues.en: So the probability of flipping a fair coin 10 times and getting zero, heads getting all tails is really, really small.
cues.zh: 擲公平硬幣十次，0次正面、全是反面的機率，非常非常小。

cues.en: It's vanishingly small.
cues.zh: 小到幾乎消失。

cues.en: Okay, so you can explore this on your own, try changing the probabilities, changing the number of coin tosses and see how that affects the shape and the center of this distribution.
cues.zh: 可以自行探索，改機率、擲幣次數，觀察分布形狀與中心如何改變。

cues.en: There are two more distributions that I would like to cover here just to give you a little bit of a sense of these distributions.
cues.zh: 還想介紹兩種分布，讓你稍微有點概念。

cues.en: And these are the T distribution and the F distribution.
cues.zh: 也就是t分布與F分布。

cues.en: T distributions are really important for T statistics for the T-test.
cues.zh: t分布對t檢定的t統計量非常重要。

cues.en: And you're gonna learn a lot more about the T-test.
cues.zh: 你會學到更多t檢定。

cues.en: You can see that a T distribution looks an awful lot like a Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: t分布看起來非常像高斯。

cues.en: It's not formally exactly a Gaussian distribution, but it is pretty close to a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 形式上不完全是，但很接近。

cues.en: There's one key parameter of a T distribution and that is this parameter, which is called the degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 關鍵參數只有一個，叫做自由度。

cues.zh: 那沒意義。

cues.en: You have two heads or three heads.
cues.zh: 只能有兩次，或三次。

cues.en: So you can only have integer values with a binomial distribution.
cues.zh: 所以二項分布只有整數值。

cues.en: Okay, so there's two more distributions that I would like to show you in this code.
cues.zh: 程式碼中，還有兩種分布要展示。

cues.en: One is a T distribution.
cues.zh: 一個是t分布。

cues.en: This we use for evaluating the statistical significance of a T-test.
cues.zh: 用來評估t檢定的統計顯著性。

cues.en: T-test is a really important test in statistics.
cues.zh: t檢定在統計中非常重要。

cues.en: There's in fact an entire section of this course just about T-test.
cues.zh: 這門課有一整節專門談它。

cues.en: You can see that the T distribution is kind of Gaussian-ish.
cues.zh: t分布有點像高斯。

cues.en: It's not formally exactly a Gaussian, but it looks pretty close to a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 形式上不完全相同，但看起來很接近。

cues.en: The key parameter is here, I call this df, that stands for degrees of freedom.
cues.zh: 關鍵參數在這裡，叫df，代表自由度。

cues.en: And I encourage you to spend a few moments and play around with this degrees of freedom parameter.
cues.zh: 鼓勵花點時間調整自由度參數。

cues.en: Essentially what happens is when this is smaller, when you have fewer degrees of freedom, then this looks less like a Gaussian because the tails are a little bit higher
cues.zh: 基本上，自由度較少時，比較不像高斯，因為尾巴稍高，

cues.en: and it's a little bit thinner in the middle.
cues.zh: 中間稍微窄一點。

cues.en: And as the degrees of freedom parameter gets larger, then it starts looking more like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 自由度增加，就越來越像高斯。

cues.en: And similar to the analytic Gaussian function we saw in the beginning of this video, this is also not formally a probability distribution
cues.zh: 類似影片開頭的解析高斯函數，這也不正式算是機率分布，

cues.en: the way that I'm plotting it now.
cues.zh: 就目前繪圖方式而言。

cues.en: And, of course, you know how to scale this so that it actually becomes a real T probability distribution.
cues.zh: 當然，你已知道如何縮放，讓它成為真正的t機率分布。

cues.en: Okay, so that brings us finally to the all important F distribution.
cues.zh: 最後，是非常重要的F分布。

cues.en: The F distribution is used to evaluate the statistical significance of ANOVAs and regressions and general linear model.
cues.zh: 用來評估ANOVA、迴歸與一般線性模型的統計顯著性。

cues.en: So we will talk quite a bit about F statistics as well.
cues.zh: F統計量也會深入討論。

cues.en: So here's what an F distribution looks like.
cues.zh: 這是F分布的樣子。

cues.en: It's strictly positive so it doesn't have any negative values.
cues.zh: 嚴格為正，所以沒有負值。

cues.en: And also it looks actually a little bit like a log normal distribution in the sense that there's a lot of values clustered towards the left
cues.zh: 也有點像對數常態，左邊聚集很多值，

cues.en: and there's fewer large values off towards the right.
cues.zh: 右邊大數值比較少。

cues.en: And you can ignore this warning here.
cues.zh: 可以忽略這個警告。

cues.en: This is just because I start x to be at exactly zero here, so we get a bit of a warning.
cues.zh: 只是因為x從恰好0開始，所以有警告。

cues.en: This is not an error message, that's just a warning
cues.zh: 不是錯誤訊息，只是警告，

cues.en: that we're trying to take the log of zero, so it's no problem.
cues.zh: 我們試著取0的對數，沒有問題。

cues.en: So there's two degrees of freedom parameters for the F distribution and essentially those change the shape of the distribution in terms of how far out it is from zero
cues.zh: F分布有兩個自由度參數，主要改變分布離0有多遠，

cues.en: and what it looks like here all the way on the left side.
cues.zh: 以及最左邊的樣子。

cues.en: So for example, we can make this smaller, we can change the numerator degrees of freedom, make that smaller, and then you see it doesn't come back down, it stays high up again.
cues.zh: 例如設小一點，減小分子自由度，會看到不再下降，而是維持高處。

cues.en: All right, so we covered a lot in this video, in this code, but I want to give you quite a lot of code that you can use to play around with, to spend some time with and that will allow you
cues.zh: 這部影片與程式碼，內容很多，但想給你足夠程式，花時間嘗試，讓你，

cues.en: to gain some intuition about the different distributions, what they look like and how the parameters are going to affect the overall shape of the distribution.
cues.zh: 對不同分布、它們的樣子，以及參數如何影響整體形狀，建立直覺。
